subject: Flowing data between 2 functions in Server .R

messages.subject: Flowing data between 2 functions in Server .R
parts:
Hi All

I am working on plotting a decision Tree in R Shiny , I use Rpart in one of the reactive function in Server.R 

Now I want to use this Rpart object information in another reactive function in Server.R 

How can I achieve this

Basically beneath my decision tree , i want to show a table which would contain the node variable names matched up against their description from a csv file

Is it possible 

Or if in the same reactive function - Can i merge decision tree output ( PRP object) and a reactive table

output$Tree <- reactivePlot(function() {
 test <- rpart(myFormula, data = train, control = rpart.control(minsplit = 100),method="anova")
      
      d<-test$frame[c(1,2)]
      newdata <- d[ which(d$var!='<leaf>'), ]
      dd<-length(newdata$var)
      newdata$var<-substr(newdata$var, start=5, stop=length(newdata$var)+3)
      newdata$var<-gsub("(^ +)|( +$)", "", newdata$var)
     
      cpt <- read.csv("a.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = F)          
      choropleth <- merge(newdata, cp, by = c("var")) 


}
 
  output$TreeTable <- reactiveTable(function() {
    
    LIST<- choropleth    
    head(LIST, n = 150)
    
  })

I want to plot choropleth table beneath the tree on the UI


Thanks
